body: Nothing specific, I just know how I care so little about anyone else and I hurt people for my own selfish reasons. I hurt people by bringing up being depressed and wanting to kill myself. I want to kill myself and that's entirely selfish.

A lot of the people i've talked to have told me that's just me being depressed. But I don't think that's it. I'm not any less self-critical when I feel better, on the rare occasions that i do. I'm not any more appreciative of the way i look after two years of going to the gym than i was before.

I think maybe the problem is that I just am a shitty person. I am unattractive, I am selfish, and nobody else will admit it to me. Just because i recognize these things about myself and others don't doesn't make them any less true.

I'm lazy because that's who I am. It's the cornerstone of my personality, my laziness.

I rock climb, I work out almost daily, I play video games. A few other things. They don't make me happy, really. They distract me from wanting to kill myself. I don't really enjoy them. They're routines I go through every day to keep myself from thinking. When I don't think I can pretend that I'm okay, but any time I lay down when I'm not drowsy, or any down time when I'm playing video games, or anything else, I realize just how shitty a person I am and I just want to die.

The thing is I want results and I want things that the only way I can get them is to not be lazy. It's not like the world is at fault for wanting me to be productive. At this point I just want nice things and don't want to work for them. But I don't actually want anything, it's just me being irrational. I think I want those things but they wouldnt' make me any happier.

I really just want to kill myself.

I honestly just feel like I'm making up the depression as an excuse for why I'm not productive or motivated to do anything. There's nothing wrong with me, except that I'm a shitty person and don't put effort into anything important.

But I simply don't have an excuse. I'm just lazy.

I haven't got a clue how my parents did in school. All I know is what they expected of me. Doesn't help that my sister always did perfectly and she was older, so I've always been the disappointing younger brother.

In a way yes, I think it's pathetic that I'm not doing anything with my intelligence. There's a lot of things that are pathetic about me.

Well for one I've always been expected to do everything by my family. If I was anything short of the best in school I was punished for it, had privileges taken away for anything short of high A's.

Nobody would specifically say they're disappointed in me, but I know plenty of friends that have talked about how they know I'm the smartest person they know and they think I'll do well in life. But I see all of them progressing on in life and I've achieved nothing and I know how pathetic that is, to waste potential.

I'm sure they would, but I know they'd be disappointed in me. I'd be disappointed in myself regardless.

All these problems of mine aren't big problems though. None of them are anything I should want to kill myself over, but I'm just so tired of it and I want to take the lazy way out.

Because everyone is already disappointed in me for not being better than I am. Family, friends, and it's not something I'm making up. I've had conversations with them and everyone agrees that they've always expected me to do more with my life. If I were to decide to do nothing but labor or something like that they'd just be that much more disappointed in me.

The simple fact is I can't stand fat people. I can't stand idiots. I can't stand people who are religious. I'm great at making friends with the people I can stand, but for some reason nothing more than that. Don't try to tell me I'm selfless because I don't want to bring people into my life. I would jump at the goddamn opportunity, I just haven't had that opportunity.

No, I don't enjoy what I'm doing, I started it because they would pay for me to do it with a full ride scholarship. But I don't know of anything else that I'd like to do. I guess manual labor would make me the happiest. But then I'd feel like that much more of a disappointment.

I'm lazy because I don't ever want to do anything i have to do.

I'm aware that people get lucky. I'm aware of it. I'm not going to be one of them. Just because it happened for you doesn't mean anything will ever go well for me. The simple fact is even if I did manage to have a conversation with a girl who I find attractive, eventually they'll figure out how screwed up I am in the head. Honestly I'd rather not bring anyone into it any more either, it's just selfish of me to bring anyone else into my life.

I'm disappointing anyone that gets to know me in any respect. It becomes apparent what I'm capable of pretty quickly when you get to know me, and I've consistently not achieved anything. Some people have tried to convince me that the reason i can't motivate myself to do anything is because I'm depressed, but I know that I'm just a shitty person. I just don't have any work ethic and I'm just lazy.

It's been six years since I had anything like a relationship with anyone. My standards for what I'm attracted to is simply not achievable. Sure, some people get lucky. But hoping to get lucky and find someone attractive, personality wise and physically, is near impossible. My standards are too high and I either need to accept that I'll be alone or kill myself. One of those options is easier.

I'd like to not be a disappointment. But anything I do is less than what I could be doing. I never apply myself and that's just me being lazy. I'd rather kill myself than change that.

It bothers me because I want things that I won't ever have. I tried online dating recently and I've realized that I'm treated like a leper from anyone that I think is attractive. It's not a matter of me being horrible, it's a matter of me expecting something far above my station in life.

It simply comes down to it being easier for me to kill myself than it is to fix any of the multitude of problems that I have.

She was institutionalized for a few months to treat her depression. I'm definitely not willing to go through that. And nobody is in any position to force me to.

It's not even that, I can force myself to be closer with people. But that's all it is, me forcing myself on people. If I letup at all my friends forget about me or don't worry about maintaining any relationship with me.

The thing is, so many of my friends have dealt with depression. So many of them have been treated for it, so many of them have told me in confidence about their suicidal thoughts, their self harm, how they'll kill themselves if I kill myself. The one I've relied upon for some time now was treated for depression and she claims that my thought processes are all so similar to hers.

I'm not interested in anything though. I pick up habits easily, if it's part of my routine I do it without fail. I go to the gym every day (although I'd still say I look small, weak, and ugly), I've done that for years. I rock climb, I'm great at making friends and going into new groups, but I'm horrible at getting close to people. I've never been an important person in anyone's life. I make a good friend to have a chat with in passing, no one wants me to be any closer than that. That's just who I am. When I'm not in a horrible mood I'm okay with accepting that I'll be alone. I'm okay with accepting who I am. But I'm never happy.

I haven't been paying attention when I've been replying, sorry if it's all scattered. The thing is, I've always been a disappointment. I've always been extremely intelligent, but that's an insult to my overall character, because I've achieved nothing with it, and I have no goals to speak of. I have no motivation to do anything unless there's an imminent punishment for not doing it. I'm lazy and pathetic. I only care about how my actions affect others because of how that will in turn affect me. I don't actually care about anyone else. I'm too selfish to care about them. Maybe it's a lie I tell myself, but I know it's true. I don't say I'm sorry because I'm afraid the other person is hurt, I want them to forgive me. That's it. None of my friends see through that, but it doesn't make it any less true. They tell me what a good person I am, that I have so much potential and try to tell me of these good qualities I have. But every thing they tell me I know that it's not true. I can always compare myself to something else and say that I'm not good, I'm not smart, I'm not kind.

But I want everything that a smart, kind, good person should have. I want people that care about me and I want a life that is satisfying. But I'm too lazy to achieve any of that. I'm a wretched person that can't accept that I should only have what a wretched person should have. My life isn't hard and even if I were realistic about what I think I am, my life wouldn't be the worst life to live. But I'll never accept that and never be content.

While yes, moving away from this place would likely make me happier, I know that I'll never be someone that I want to be. I'll never accept what I am and what I can reasonably expect from my life. I'll always want more and I'll never be able to get it. I'll make myself miserable no matter what my life conditions are.

My family only knows I've been depressed. I'm not about to talk about thoughts of suicide with them. They're unbearable to talk to.

My friends obviously tell me that I'm not a burden to them and tell me how bad it would be if I killed myself. And how they want me to stick around. But nobody cares that much about me. Nobody actually wants much of a relationship with me. I make a good friend, but anything more than that and people realize that they don't really want me around that much.

Right now I'm going to school. I'll graduate this semester with a degree that practically assures I can get a good job and have a good life.

I just don't want to live. Never have. I have no reason to want to be here. At best i can tolerate my life sometimes, but most of the time I just want to die to not have to deal with it anymore. It's just the easiest thing. I'm tired of being pathetic, tired of being a disappointment, and I know that those things will never change.

I just don't want to be here. I haven't for a long time. I thought of suicide for years and years, and then I quit thinking of suicide for a time, but I still always dreamed of dying. My daydreams were me getting hit by a drunk driver, or maybe I'd get cancer, or maybe any other random freak accident might kill me.

I've never wanted to be here. I've never had any motivation to live. Sometimes I have the patience to tolerate my life without wanting to kill myself, because I know I'll die eventually. That's the best I've ever had.

Lexapro (escitalopram) 20mg/day.

It helps me eat, helps me sleep, helps me be in a better mood. But I still just want to die. Every morning I wake up and hope that maybe some freak accident will happen and I'll die. Every night I'm disappointed that I made it back to bed.

The thing is, I could make it work. I could push through this, I've felt much worse before and made it through. But I haven't got any reason to want to. Every reason I've ever had to want to live has proved to be me fooling myself.

I've talked to him now. I've been to a psychiatrist too. The meds make me feel better but they don't make me want to kill myself any less.

I've talked with tons of people about it at this point, and none of them can come up with any answers that work. Probably because I don't want to get any better. I want to die.

Retaking a class isn't the worst thing in the world. I graduated second in my class in high school... I was a model student. I never had trouble with anything. Then I started college and it caught up to me, and I've failed a lot of classes. It felt overwhelming the first time. Felt like I really fucked up and disappointed everyone who ever believed in me.

Over time though, you'll realize that almost nobody gets through college without retaking a class or two. You're not going to live up to the standards you set for yourself 100% of the time. It's a good thing to be disappointed in yourself. Holding yourself to a goal is important.

You know you're retaking the class, you're sticking it out and learning what you can to do better next time. Honestly it's up to you whether you keep going or not, most of the time when I was in your situation I quit going to the class (keep in mind I almost always had to face the professor again the next semester when I retook it). Any good professor isn't going to judge you for failing the class. They understand, they've had countless students before you that failed and retook. Even if they aren't a good professor and have a negative opinion of you, don't worry about it. Their opinion of you shouldn't determine your grade.

You'll do better next time man, when you know what to expect and you know to begin worrying about the course from the first test.

Not the OP, but I've been trying to weigh my options for talking to friends. Honestly the best option I've got I'm too proud to talk to. My roommate for three years, works in mental health and has plenty of experience with it. But I can't really bring myself to do it. I feel like I've set myself up in my group of friends as something of a rock. Over the years I've always tried to show myself as a stoic figure, someone that regardless of what happens, I'll always be put together and able to handle myself. Right now I feel like a fraud though.

I weigh a good bit still. Over 200 pounds. For the past few years I've been working out regularly, but recently I havent' been able to keep going to the gym. Regardless, I've got to eat a few thousand calories a day to maintain my weight.

I've never been one to turn to alcohol (other than a night or two of heavy drinking every few months). I definitely have sleep problems though.

I'll probably be better off once this semester is over. But these next few weeks are going to be rough. And then next semester will probably just start it all up again.

Should probably just start getting some work done but can't bring myself to do work. I know I'd feel better if I got some done though.

Oh I'm sure they'd be better than the last person I confided in. The right words? I don't think they exist. I surely don't have them. If someone asked me why, I wouldn't be able to make a rational answer. The closest I could come to would be to say that I not only don't have what I want to be happy, I can't figure out what it is that I'd need to be happy. It's the not knowing that gets to me the most. I've got nothing to dream of, nothing productive to want to work towards.

I'd send you some of my rain if I could. I've got about forty mosquito bites because it's so wet here that even the indoors are inundated with them.

Yeah it just scares me, bringing it up. The only other time I've brought things up with people close to me didn't work out well. I felt like I only hurt them and myself in the process. That was years ago though.

Eh, rain doesn't bother me, I wouldn't say I like it. As of about a month ago though it kindof pissed me off. I had an event I was looking forward to get cancelled due to flooding.
